en.purpose: To determine the clinical T, N, and M categories and the corresponding TNM stage group for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.
en.use:
Use to classify cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) of the head and neck (excluding eyelids) by selecting the appropriate clinical TNM categories:
- Clinical T category (Tx, T0, Tis, T1, T2, T3, T4a, T4b), based on primary tumour size, depth of invasion, perineural invasion, and invasion of cortical bone, bone marrow, skull base, or axial skeleton as defined in UICC 8.
- Clinical N category (N0, N1, N2a, N2b, N2c, N3a, N3b), based on regional lymph node involvement, including number of involved nodes, maximum nodal diameter, laterality, and presence of extranodal extension.
- Clinical M category (M0, M1), based on the presence or absence of distant metastases.

The guideline then derives the TNM stage group (Stage 0–IV) from the selected TNM categories using the UICC 8 stage grouping table for head and neck cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma:
- Stage 0: Tis N0 M0
- Stage I: T1 N0 M0
- Stage II: T2 N0 M0
- Stage III: T3 N0 M0, or T1–T3 N1 M0
- Stage IVA: T1–T3 N2–N3 M0, or T4 Any N M0
- Stage IVB: Any T Any N M1
en.misuse: Not to be used for pathological TNM staging, staging of eyelid squamous cell carcinoma, or staging of non-head and neck malignancies.

other_details.en: A structured guideline used to determine the clinical Tumour-Node-Metastasis (TNM) classification and stage grouping for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) of the head and neck (excluding eyelids), according to the UICC 8th edition.
